description: Read third-party lab reports (COAs) by lot number or product. Each report gives the lab, lot, test date, identity result, purity, potency, a report link and a link to verify it on the lab's own site. Use it for questions about testing, purity or a lot number, and to check that a lab report is real. Use get_product for prices and stock.

query.description: Lot number from the vial label, or a product name or slug.

name: get_coa
title: Get lab reports
